definitions.explanation: A feeling of uncertainty or lack of conviction about something.

examples.japanese: {疑|うたが}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挟|はさ}む→挟む：00091_hasamu⟧。

examples.english: There is no room for doubt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02551_taisuru⟧{疑|うたが}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}えた→消える：01086_kieru⟧。

notes:
{疑|うたが}い is the noun form of the verb ⟦{疑|うたが}う→疑う：01929_utagau⟧ (to doubt).
